title: Pod Salt Nexus Mango Peach Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Mango Peach Ice Nic Salt is a tropical blend of smooth Mango and sun-ripened Peach, finished with a streak of cooling Ice. The Mango offers lush sweetness with a soft, rounded texture, while the Peach adds a brighter, juicy edge. A crisp icy layer ties the flavour together, leaving a cool finish that complements the fruit without overpowering it. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is made for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable vape kits , vape pens , and starter vape kits . The nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid absorption and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, making it ideal for those seeking authentic flavour with discreet vapour. Part of the Pod Salt Nexus line, Mango Peach Ice demonstrates the collection’s ability to balance fruit profiles with precision. Each bottle is crafted in the UK using premium-grade ingredients, guaranteeing a consistent and reliable vape.
